title.purpose: The record name on a plate.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one committing action in a plate.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 600 14px/1 var(--font-ui, Archivo, sans-serif); background: var(--ink, #16181b); color: var(--plate, #fbfbfa); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #16181b); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 16px; min-height: 46px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 110ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #16181b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: State printed onto a plate; hero variant rotated.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px 7px 2px; border-radius: 3px; font: 700 10.5px/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; color: var(--ink, #16181b); } .ds-stamp-hero { font-size: 13px; padding: 5px 10px 4px; border-width: 2px; transform: rotate(-3deg); }

components.name: Callout row
components.description: Numbered next action on a plate.
components.html: 1Record progress4 tasks on today's plate
components.css: .ds-callout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 14px 4px; min-height: 60px; color: var(--ink, #16181b); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d4d8db); } .ds-callout small { display: block; color: var(--ink-2, #474d55); font-size: 13px; } .ds-callout-n { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--signal, #c8102e); color: #fff; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 700 13px/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-callout:active { background: var(--plate-2, #f1f3f3); }

components.name: Plate
components.description: A record as a catalogue plate.
components.css: .ds-plate { background: var(--plate, #fbfbfa); border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(22 24 27 / 0.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgb(22 24 27 / 0.18); } .ds-plate-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d4d8db); font: 600 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--ink-2, #474d55); } .ds-plate h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 760; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

components.name: Text input
components.css: .ds-input { font: 400 16px/1.4 Archivo, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #16181b); background: var(--plate, #fbfbfa); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #a8aeb4); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; min-height: 46px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ink, #16181b); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(22 24 27 / 0.14); }

narrative.overview: Every record is a part on a satin plate: mono part code, condensed title, state printed as a stamp. Pale steel ground, graphite ink, brushed hairlines, one signal red for next actions and blocking states. Phone first, with a graphite bottom bar that becomes an index rail on desktop.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Signal red only for next actions, counts, the current tab and blocking states.

rules.name: The Part Code Rule
rules.body: Identifiers, quantities, dates and money in tabular mono; names never in mono.

rules.name: The No Nested Plate Rule
rules.body: A plate never holds a bordered box; records inside are hairline rows.

dos: Do give every record its part code.
Do keep at most three numbered callouts.
Do gate hover behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
donts: Don't show state as a dot.
Don't use glyphs in place of icons or em-dashes in copy.
